eventDetail.scope: ICEAAI 2027 provides an international forum for researchers, academics, and industry professionals to present recent advances and emerging developments in intelligent systems and advanced information technologies. The conference welcomes original contributions addressing theoretical foundations, methodologies, algorithms, and practical applications that enhance the interaction between humans, machines, and complex systems. Topics of interest encompass artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, computational intelligence, autonomous systems, cyber physical systems, human centered technologies, and related interdisciplinary areas. Emphasis is placed on innovative approaches that contribute to intelligent decision making, system optimization, and sustainable technological development across diverse domains.
